mapper.insert: INSERT INTO conversation ( type, status, create_time, update_time, remark, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{type}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW(), #{remark}, 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS conversationId, c.type, c.status, MAX(cm.send_time) AS lastMessageTime, (SELECT cm2.content FROM conversation_message cm2 WHERE cm2.conversation_id = c.id ORDER BY cm2.send_time DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastMessage, (SELECT CASE WHEN cm3.sender_type = 0 THEN -- 普通用户 (SELECT CASE WHEN u2.name IS NOT NULL AND u2.name != '' THEN u2.name ELSE u2.phone END FROM user_info u2 WHERE u2.id = cm3.sender_id) WHEN cm3.sender_type = 1 THEN -- 管理员 (SELECT CASE WHEN a.name IS NOT NULL AND a.name != '' THEN a.name ELSE a.username END FROM admin_info a WHERE a.id = cm3.sender_id) ELSE '系统' -- 系统用户 END FROM conversation_message cm3 WHERE cm3.conversation_id = c.id ORDER BY cm3.send_time DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastMessageSender, CASE WHEN cp2.participant_id != #{userId} THEN CASE cp2.participant_type WHEN 0 THEN -- 普通用户 (SELECT CASE WHEN u3.name IS NOT NULL AND u3.name != '' THEN u3.name ELSE u3.phone END FROM user_info u3 WHERE u3.id = cp2.participant_id) WHEN 1 THEN -- 管理员 (SELECT CASE WHEN a.name IS NOT NULL AND a.name != '' THEN a.name ELSE a.username END FROM admin_info a WHERE a.id = cp2.participant_id) WHEN 2 THEN -- 系统 CASE c.type WHEN 0 THEN '客服' ELSE '系统' END ELSE '未知' END ELSE '未知' END AS targetName FROM conversation c INNER JOIN conversation_participant cp1 ON c.id = cp1.conversation_id AND cp1.participant_id = #{userId} INNER JOIN conversation_participant cp2 ON c.id = cp2.conversation_id LEFT JOIN conversation_message cm ON c.id = cm.conversation_id WHERE c.is_deleted = 0 AND cp1.is_deleted = 0 AND cp2.is_deleted = 0 AND (cp1.id != cp2.id OR cp1.id = cp2.id) GROUP BY c.id, c.type, c.status, cp2.participant_id, cp2.participant_type ORDER BY lastMessageTime DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE conversation SET status = #{status}, end_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
